notes.title: Update Note v1.2
notes.content:
Mayors,
Version 1.2 is here. Now mayors can choose what dice you want to use before term start in the map selector. A new four face dice has been added to choose from.

notes.title: Update Note v1.1
notes.content:
Mayors,
Dice Mayor has been updated to version 1.1! Version 1.1 adds the ability to choose a map. Each map has an unique land lot layout, which will bring new strategy to your term. Before term start, mayors can click the map button on top left of main screen to choose a map. If no map is chosen, map from previous term will be applied automatically.

Change Log:
[olist]
[*] Add the ability to choose a map
[*] Add a new unlockable map: Tiny Isle
[*] Fix the bug that some achievements do not trigger
[*] Fix the bug that language for filter is not correct in City Archive
[/olist]

notes.title: Update note version v1.0.1
notes.content: City Archive has been built! Now mayors have access to this in game wiki by clicking the icon on top left of the screen.

notes.title: A Thank you note
notes.content:
Dear Mayors,
It has been three days since Dice Mayor released on Steam. I would like to take this opportunity and say thank you from the bottom of my heart for purchasing the game.
So what will the future of Dice Mayor be like? Well, I have several ideas in mind.
[olist]
[*]Dice City will build its own archive.
 This will serve as an in game wiki where mayors can look for any information they want, from buildings to policies and many more.
[*]New city layout.
Tired of vanially layout? New city layout will bring new possibilities to your terms.
[*]More Dice! 
How can dice city be completed without more dice? More dice will be added so mayors can choose your favorite dice for governing.
[*] And more buildings!
 
There is also something I would like to mention. As I am the sole developer of Dice Mayor (and will likely remain so in the foreseeable future), I may not be able to update the game frequently and quickly. But I will deliver all the contents listed here, sooner or later (though might not specifically following the order above).
If you like or dislike the game, please leave a review or contact me directly at shanshigames@gmail.com. If you want to see any specific feature be added to the game, or want to see anything changes in the game, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Again, thank you all for your support! Let us make Dice City a better place together.

ShanShi
